notes.title: Pirates! MOD - EoD Update to v4.1.037
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/46b26176950f874d984d7dcca06b7eed4717d439.png[/img]
[h1][b]Pirates![/b][/h1]
Pirates is a free modification for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/530160/Eve_of_Destruction__REDUX_VIETNAM/]Eve of Destruction - Redux[/url], which was inspired by the Battlefield modification 'Pirates'.
Everything currently in the Pirates mod for Eve of Destruction is obtained either from freely available assets, was purchased online or was self-made.
Many thanks go to Dnamro for the idea and a lot of help on this mod!
Pirates offers a wide variety of different ships and boats with a wide range of naval combat options. The ship's cannons vary greatly on firepower and it takes a lot of practice to be able to hit targets accurately.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/cdbe8af3ef11a0a67a9302f5125cd7cdcc5716ed.jpg[/img]
Fight in huge sea battles against enemy ships or on land against bots with swords, pistols, axes and muskets.
You can even take a ride in a balloon to get behind enemy lines.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/769ba4b373134467227cafa4f91359e2d67e0d1e.jpg[/img]
The game is currently available for Singleplayer only. Multiplayer may be added if there is enough interest.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/75f6f910003699ac4ac00e912dff4102b7ab22fa.jpg[/img]
The MOD comes with the main game Eve of Destruction - Redux VIETNAM and gets updated automatically!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/9cd80b455b17c36c7e9833190b29da839351f388.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Vietnam! Another huge update![/b][/h1]
EoD has got another huge update. Nearly everything has been revised and a lot of changes have been made in nearly every map to make the gameplay more exciting.

Read more about the change -i.e. the new headshot gameplay- in the Changelog below.

New maps come from EoD classic: Brown Water Navy and Hai Van Pass.

[h1][b]Brown Water Navy classic[/b][/h1]
This map is predestinated for boats and it has a lot of it!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/18ff11d6eada7966022c839b303929382438812b.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hai Van Pass[/b][/h1]
The most beautiful road in Vietnam is scene of a fictive battle. The map also comes with a new game mode: Anti Air! Jump into a ZPU-2 or the new ZSU 23-4 Schilka and get down some bandits from the skies!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/369d8fc1c9c917563b559a3c68fddd3b09b6226a.jpg[/img]

[code]CHANGELOG

    GENERAL
    - headshot gameplay added
    - new game mode: Anti Air
    - tips shown while maps are loading
    - fixed a bug where player spawns on a bot
    - fixed a bug with the code for all AI-bullets

    MODS
    - Pirates mod added

    VEHICLES
    - new vehicle: ZSU 23-4 Schilka (in map: Hai Van Pass)
    - improved Alpha boat

    HANDWEAPONS
    - L1A1 SLR: mag set to 20 bullets, improved aiming

    AI
    - improved AI weapon alignment
    - added footsteps to infantry bots
    - added voices to infantry bots
    - bots won't push vehicles/wrecks anymore
    - bots won't block your way anymore if you're driving
    - re-added die-animations

    MAPS
    - all maps revised, changes to improve gameplay
    - new map: Brown Water Navy Classic
    - new map: Hai Van Pass
    - Surrounded: night mode added
    - added short description to game mode selection 
    - performance improvements and revised all maps!
    - removed map: My Lai
[/code]

notes.title: EoD Update to v4.1 - World Cup 2018 in Russia
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/493384647b5721a70ee71a42042337616998dcb8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]World Cup 2018[/b][/h1]
In time for the start of the football/soccer World Cup 2018 in Russia, the update for Eve of Destruction (EoD) has been completed.
On this occasion I brought a simple football game into EoD.
You can find the football area in the new map 'Cao Lanh' (Game Category: Fun).

The rules of the game are simple:
You play until a team (USA/Vietnam) has reached 10 goals!
If the ball leaves the playing field, a new ball is spawned at the center point.
To shoot, you just need to go to the ball.
The kicking is automatic and the shot strength depends on the running speed.
The shot goes in the direction of sight, which means you can definitely hit the target!
Do not expect any strategically playing bots, they are only amateurs, so a stud counter team :)

[h1][b]Update to v4.1 - completely new AI[/b][/h1]
The code for the infantry bots was completely rewritten because the old AI left much to be desired.
In short, the new AI code is only 20% of the old code, but has much more features. The bots and the performance have become noticeably better!

[h1][b]Update to v4.1 - new: AC-119 Gunship[/b][/h1]
As a gunner in an AC-119 you can set a lot of fire in the map 'The Ricepaddies'.

[h1][b]New Map: Saigon Suburbia[/b][/h1]
This map also comes with a new game mode: Traffic survival :)
Anyone who has ever seen pictures of traffic in Saigon or Hanoi knows what is going on in the streets.
Of course, the map can also be played in normal combat mode.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/973f3eb88e9de1d86282483a8186f9090597f864.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Map: Welcome to the jungle[/b][/h1]
As announced in the latest news, this is probably the most detailed map for EoD ever built.
It is playable in both day- and night-mode.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/5e56ed7e6173996b8d57b8d04c72605090bbfddb.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Map: Green Hell[/b][/h1]
Green Hell already existed in old versions of EoD, but this is a completely new map with some surprises in the undergrowth! 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/47f59475f53b1f1399df3147852abe38c31d20fc.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Map: My Lai (Singleplayer only)[/b][/h1]
The My Lai massacre is a hard topic and was the beginning of the end of the Vietnam War.
Of course this topic is not to be missed in EoD, but the story here is changed somewhat: As a gunner in a helicopter you should stop the massacre! (Wich is what nearly happened this day!)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/0e7d43cc843b93f948d28428d5205310dbac97c8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Map: Cao Lanh (Singleplayer only / Category: Fun)[/b][/h1]
The above mentioned soccer map.
Just the right thing for the game breaks during the World Cup, it's really fun!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/78fecdf0b948397bc0d8034e1c483fcc665ddbba.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Update to v4.1 - Changelog[/b][/h1]
All changes in the new version.

CHANGELOG

	GENERAL
	- new game type: SOCCER (map Cao Lanh)

	- new aircraft LI-2
	- new jungle hut 3D models

	SINGLEPLAYER
	- added map filters
	- new healthbar shows the health status
	- new doorgunner game with C-119 gunship (in map The Ricepaddies)

	AI
	- completely new AI code for infantry bots
        - added new animations

	MAPS
	- new map: Cao Lanh (SOCCER, SP only)

notes.title: Update anouncement to v4.1 - Summer 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/aac8b7e6909986e17bb0ec537c52f13f0da237c2.jpg[/img]
I am happy to announce a new update.
With the next patch - which should be released in summer 2018 (northern hemisphere) - massive improvements of the AI and a lot of new features will come into the game.

[h1]AI[/h1]
The code for the AI has been reduced by 80%, but has significantly more features.
The bots are now much better, which you'll notice after a few minutes of playing.
The pathfinding, the accuracy and much other things are significantly different from older versions.

The bots now attack in platoons and no longer single as before. Of course, this increases the difficulty but also the tension!

[h1]AI animations[/h1]
That all bots run in the same way seemed to be subprisoned. As a result, the bots animations were made more varied and new animations were added, at the request of some players.
This is easier said than done, because there are not many available player animations for Unity, and I unfortunately cannot create them.
If someone has a source for it I would be grateful for hints!

[h1]AC-119 gunship[/h1]
In the discussion forum, someone asked about an armed AC-119, which was used in the Vietnam War.
The plane was already in game (unarmed as a transporter) and therefore it was possible to make something out of it without any problems.
And I have to say, the result is awesome and it's really fun!
As like the ' Doorgunner ' games, where you sit in the MG of a Huey, the AC-119 is also shot from the side with an M-134.
The projectiles leave a luminous trace and depending on what you hit on the ground, you set the environment on fire.
Maybe I'll upload a video soon.

[h1]Other new features[/h1]
- Lots of new 3D jungle hut models
- Two new VC and NVA soldiers 3d models
- New NVA aircraft Li-2 (Russian version of the C-47)
- New map: Green Hell (Brandnew-no remake!)
- New map: My Lai (Brandnew-no remake!)
- New map: Saigon Suburbia (Brandnew-no remake!)
- New map: Welcome to the Jungle (Brandnew-no remake!)

[h1]Welcome to the Jungle[/h1]
The most graphically sophisticated map ever built for EOD is likely to be the new 'Welcome to the Jungle'.
No other map contains so much details.

Jumping fishes, flies, mushrooms, soil vegetation in the jungle and on meadows, a fabulous moon, searchlights, traps with flares and fireflies in the night version of the map and much more. The map just looks great.

notes.title: Update to v4.0.983
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/f832cebe840802e8df99a0f96fab18766b5beb10.png[/img]
With 7 new maps, controller support, noticeable improvements of the bots and much more, the new version is a huge update.
The bots were mostly expelled, that they repeatedly shoot through walls. But also the selection of the opponent has been improved - so infantry will no more shoot at tanks with AK-47 or M-16 ;)

All maps were performance-checked and the result is a significant increase in FPS.

The maps are remakes of many well-known maps.

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
You can drive/fly the vehicles with controller now. Tested with Xbox One, Steam and 2 dozend other controllers.
But because of the extremely different hardware there's no guarantee, that your controller or joystick will work. Just try it out!

[h1]Bad Moon Rising[/h1]
Is one of three well known old maps from the early days of EoD. It is a night-map with a densely covered swamp and is really exciting, because you often see the opponents very late!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/4f7a8d443df0c05ee5e39f1e5301e2979e020c6d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hill 937[/h1]
Also a well known old map about the famous hard-fought Hamburger Hill.
Like many others it has a day- and night mode and offers plenty of variety.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/ff611b237dfe7292bdbca42ced6165c2a955fca5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Lam Son[/h1]
Lam Son was a very popular map in the old BF42 modification, because the relatively small map offers very quick fights and race for the flags.
This also happens in the re-make, at least the feeling against bots is almost the same as with the old EoD!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/c5af4d46bf0af2d22e5253974ed1d6f5e5b54cdd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Surrounded[/h1]
You have to defend an US-Camp while Charlie is attacking from all sides!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/3adbfe54d6a224016c535e9c624d718e32a99f20.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sa Pa[/h1]
Is like Lam Son a very small map with fast fights. It also was very popular in the old game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/5dbbc03c8018b523b1529d6701db3cb4c5b878a1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Vinh Loc[/h1]
The third ancient map from EoD. Capture an island that is hold by Vietcong.
But please use one of the boats, helicopters or aircrafts and don't swim ;)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/be842ae345e493ca2b313767ae6fb4af58fb1f8a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Pleiku Mansion[/h1]
Is a brandnew map. NVA tries to hold a nobel quarter of Pleiku and gets attacked by a lot of US infantry and tanks. This is harder than expected, because the tanks can logically only be attacked with bazookas, but there are enough of them lying around the hot spots.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/268bbef789931bf17dc2db03f2f5b584d798b009.jpg[/img]


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[code]
    GENERAL
    - added controller support
    - improvements on bots
    - performance improvements in all maps

    MENU
    - fixed content showroom performance bug
    - added controller settings in options
    - added benchmark and map-show in options

    MULTIPLAYER
    - added 2 new server regions: 
      Russia West (Moscow) and 
      Russia East (Khabarovsk)
    
    MAPS
    - new map: Bad Moon Rising
    - new map: Hill 937
    - new map: Lam Son
    - new map: Pleiku Mansion
    - new map: Sa Pa
    - new map: Surrounded
    - new map: Vinh Loc
[/code]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/5f8e2b29f415bf8339a7fbc63b5f702620c2611c.jpg[/img]
Some days ago v4.0.964 was announced, but a damaged file and some bugs with the new korean team caused some trouble.

Today v4.0.967 is released wich will fix these problems and brings some other nice things.

[code]
	GENERAL
	- rifles, sniper & shotgun bullets realism improved
	
	MULTIPLAYER
	- improved AI
	- fixed a bug with the new region selection
	- fixed a bug with the flags and the new korean team
	- fixed a bug with the bots shooting for remote players

        MAPS
	- Run through the jungle: fixed a bug in multiplayer
[/code]

[h1]Older news posting
Update to v4.0.964[/h1]

A new map, a new soldier team, improvements on the AI and some more realistic sound enviroment are the main things coming with the new update. 
And finally! The new version will stop tanks from bouncing like balls if they collide with other things and won't fly around like a balloon anymore.
A script bug fought against the physics wich caused this damn bug that made me go grey :)

And there are some more changes. Learn more in the changelog below.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/097ca39e52914a93888d4f4da3d7c6f816467537.jpg[/img]

[h1]CHANGELOG[/h1]
[code]
    GENERAL
    - added South Korea (ROK) soldier team (A Shau Valley)
    - fixed tanks bouncing and air-riding bug when colliding
      with other objects
    - improved AI
    - improved pathfinding
    - bots now primary try to capture neutral flags
    - improved mini map system
    - added distant shots sound ambiance
    - added different ladder sounds (metal/wood/rope/ivy)
    - new fire sound: M-1911
    - new fire sound: TT-33
    - fixed ammobox HUD reload-display
    - new players are prompted to change their name from Player 1
    - highscores from Player 1 will no more be saved online

    MAPS
    - new map: Kill Colonel Shortz
    - A Shau Valley: added second gamemode with ROK soldiers
    - NVA Junglebase: added second gamemode with rain, thunder and
      flooded tunnels

    SINGLEPLAYER
    - fixed the hymn playing double if 2 or more players take a flag

    MULTIPLAYER
    - region selection added
    - room names now get selected randomly without players name
    (room name still can be changed manually)
    - added a function in admin-menu to kick bots separated by team
    you now can play humans only vs bots only
[/code]

notes.title: Update Release! Eve of Destruction 15 years anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/041def4b6901155b0339e2c72f3094fed8bdec50.jpg[/img]

[h1]15 years anniversary[/h1]
15 years ago the mod-team and the modification for Battlefield were founded.

After EoD for Battlefield 1942 in 2003 the game/modification was released for Battlefield:Vietnam in 2005 and for Battlefield 2 in 2007 before it got a standalone game with EoD-Redux in 2016.

[h1]Anniversary discount[/h1]
We take this anniversary as an opportunity to reduce the price for EoD to around 50% !

[h1]Update Release - EoD v4.0.917 available[/h1]
As announced an updated version is available, which is really extensive.
In addition to a significantly better AI there is now also a campaign-mode, artillery support and many other improvements. 5 new maps increase the mappool to 45 maps!


[h1]Campaign mode[/h1]
You can select a singleplayer campaign and play through different maps now.

[h1]AI difficulty[/h1]
In each map you can select the difficulty of AI when round starts.

[h1]New handweapon TT-33[/h1]
The completely wrong Nambu could at last be replaced by a TT-33 model!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/c7419bdd500d5983607044eb796ca5140fefcf42.jpg[/img]

[h1]Binoculars for request of artillery support[/h1]
The binoculars can now requesting artillery support. This feature should be used only on large distances ;)

[h1]Spectator mode improved[/h1]
The spec-camera is now freely rotatable and can be switched to the next BOT by pressing 'K'.

[h1]AI enhancements[/h1]
Bots can be sometimes very difficult.
Everyone does what he wants, nobody does what he should, but everyone joins!
To improve this the AI code has been completely revised.
The result is much more action in game.
Of course it still can happen that a bot still doesn't know where to go first, but this should be reduced to some seconds now.

[h1]5 new maps[/h1]
4 old maps from the early times of EoD and 1 brandnew map were implemented:

[h1]Run through the jungle[/h1]
Two action-packed infantry modes are available and bring a different feel of the game in each mode.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/4ee56d2707d2342e48113ecb01076914bc3596b3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Closefire[/h1]
A deep gorge, a temple in the forest and huts on an indomitable mountain were the trademark of Closefire. All of this was retained in the new edition and the flair of the map is breathtaking.
As a bonus, this map is also available in zombie mode (night-time)!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/5d656fe53b4b751884aff3fd62caf459aa714349.jpg[/img]

[h1]Battle of Long Tan[/h1]
A brandnew map is Battle of Long Tan (1966) where 108 inexperienced Australian soldiers had to defend their base against 2500 Vietcong.
In addition, you can play this map as 'Doorgunner'.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/ab103cadd0050c99c0f06609033ffa662ed2e6a6.jpg[/img]

[h1]Marble Mountain[/h1]
If the weather outside is pressing on your mind you should consider playing this beautifulweathermap! The NVA has to take this hill by walking or with the tank...
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/630444bd0a5658ce5339d09089d02611c9305c9c.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Shau Valley[/h1]
Oldies but goldies. Another conversion of an old EoD map.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/784a918432d11697c4cdb3443e257f18c705b149.jpg[/img]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/8d90246d1ba70d30314125f4321b910584657f44.png[/img]
As promised, a first major update comes right at the beginning of the year.
In addition to other improvements to the AI, the accuracy and much more, there is some new content.

[h1]Operation Arc Light[/h1]
The map Operation Arc Light is a pure dogfight map. Beginners is recommended to display the player's name, to distinguish friend from enemy :)
Watch the second video in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/530160]our shop[/url] to learn more about the scene.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/f65311e35199b90fd9f19a01e7a946d8f51099fd.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dien Bien Phu[/h1]
In the "first part of the Viet Nam war' the French fought against the Viet Minh. The Viet Minh team was newly included in the game and is nothing more than the Vietcong just with other hats.
These hats look a little bit ugly, but they shouldn't be more pretty than in real life ;)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/a6f4603d251d6fec27129efb154be6dbeff600d8.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/b4660f2e90fe9a95061126a3b43c55b59e28df70.jpg[/img]

[code]EoD v.4.0.901
	
	GAME
	- Viet Minh soldiers added
	- decreased player jump height
	- improved tree billboarding for helicopters
	  (so trees won't popup unrealistic anymore)
	- bots are shown on minimap now (in selected maps)
	- added music titles from EoD classic
	- added a music player for each scene (SP only)
	- tanks & APC added code to stop bouncing
	- on Dec 31 & Jan 1 a new years firework is shown in menu

	SINGLEPLAYER

notes.content:

notes.title: EoD v4.0.886 released
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26426273/8d90246d1ba70d30314125f4321b910584657f44.png[/img]
As promised - however faster as expected - the update to v4.0.886 was finished today and is available on Steam!

The changes are extensive and especially the AI was improved.

Also there's another scene called [b]All Along The Watchtower[/b] that should remind of Hamburger Hill and of course Jimmy Hendrix.

The most important change is the factor for bots in SP. You may select a multiplier from 2x to 10x depending on your machine. So instead of 30 bots you'll have 300 of these guys if you select 10x!
But of course this has influence on the performance so it's recommended to start with a lower factor first!

Enjoy the new version it has a really nice action now!

[h1]Here's the official Changelog:[/h1]
[code]
	GAME
	- fixed the french flag
	- fixed audio bug playing hymns at flag for several times in multiplayer

	HUD
	- colored health display

	AI
	- improved AI code
	- added a multiplier for number of bots in Combat mode (2,3,4,5,6,7,8,10x)
	  (This affects the performance! Try a lower value first!)
	- improved weapon alignment
	- removed die animations with physic ragdolls
	
	HANDWEAPONS
	- fixed a bug with the camera position while going downhills
	- fixed weapon pickup for AK-47, M-60, PPSH-41 and RPK

	VEHICLES
	- M-41 Walker Bulldog turret rotation fixed

	MAPS
	- new map: All Along The Watchtower
	- performance improvements
	- Brige Ruin: fixed tank AI navigation
	- Que Son Valley: fixed tank AI navigation
	- Radiotower: fixed tank AI navigation
	- Brown Water Navy: fixed a wrong spawnpoint in multiplayer
	- Haiphong Harbor: fixed object culling
[/code]
